format.title:
The format,
zone by zone
format.lede: ATHX runs continuously, with no break off the clock. Each zone tests a different physical quality, which is why general preparation matters as much as specific preparation.

zones.name: Warm-up zone
zones.description: Guided warm-up, mobility and activation before the official clock starts.

zones.name: Strength zone
zones.description: 2027 season: 1RM shoulder-to-overhead, 2RM back squat and 3RM deadlift. The score is the total load lifted.

zones.name: Refuel zone
zones.description: Active recovery window: hydration, breathing, mental preparation for the next block.

zones.name: Endurance zone
zones.description: 2027 season: a fixed-distance run, then as many SkiErg metres as possible, all within a 24-minute cap. You need to manage your pace without blowing up before the last block.

zones.name: Recovery zone
zones.description: Recovery before the toughest part of the competition. Only the Strength, Endurance and Metcon X zones count towards the ranking.

zones.name: Metcon X
zones.description: High-intensity finale: rower, dumbbells, bench press, sandbag squats, burpees. This is often where the ranking is decided.

program.title:
A program that
adapts to your PRs
program.lede: No generic loads. Your working percentages are calculated from your current squat, overhead press and deadlift.

blocks.title: Strength block
blocks.description: 3 cycles of 4 weeks building load on the back squat, deadlift and overhead work, with steps calculated from your PRs so you arrive sharp without being burnt out.

blocks.title: Endurance & conditioning block
blocks.description: Running, SkiErg, rower and linked circuits to build the capacity to hold 2h30 of continuous effort, not just an isolated effort.

blocks.title: Metcon X simulation
blocks.description: Race-like sessions reproducing the fatigue-strength-functional sequence of the last block, so you don't discover it on race day.

cta.title:
Enter your PRs,
get your program
cta.lede: Enter your current loads for a preview of your strength block steps. The full program, calculated from your PRs and written in French, is sent after purchase.

faq.question: Is the program suitable if I've never done ATHX?
faq.answer: Yes. The strength block starts from your current PRs whatever your level, and the endurance block is progressive. The Lite category is designed for a first participation.

faq.question: What if I haven't tested my PRs recently?
faq.answer: The program includes a week 0 of guided tests to set up-to-date PRs before calculating your training steps.

faq.question: Does the program work for training as a pair?
faq.answer: Loads are individual, but the endurance block and Metcon X simulation sessions can be done together.

faq.question: Which language is the program in?
faq.answer: The program is written in French. The sessions mostly use numbers, loads and exercise names (many of them in English), so they stay easy to follow with basic French or a translation tool.

faq.question: In what format do I get the program?
faq.answer: A PDF organised by week, readable on mobile or printable, sent to the email address given at purchase.
